name: dsews
description: Drug Shortage Early Warning System (DSEWS) - Pharmaceutical supply-chain decision-support prototype

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && concurrently -n SERVER,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.db:setup: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run db:generate --workspace=server && npm run db:migrate --workspace=server && npm run db:seed --workspace=server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/shared && npm run test --workspace=server
scripts.render-build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npx prisma generate --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --workspace=server
